# SOMA photography: audit of the v1 development set (131 images)

*Digital Art Director · phase B2 · 1 Nov 2026. Generated by `brand/photography/tools/render-audit.mjs` from `audit/audit-v1.txt`; do not hand-edit.*
*Contact sheets: `audit/sheets/*.jpg`. Recrop previews (crop box in Oxblood, result on the right): `audit/recrops-*.jpg`.*

## Result

| Verdict | Count | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| **keep** | 2 | Used as is (development asset, AI label stays). |
| **recrop** | 32 | Usable once the AI frame artefacts are cut off. Boxes in `audit/recrops.json`; `node brand/photography/tools/recrops.mjs --apply` writes `<name>-v2.jpg` next to the original. |
| **replace** | 97 | Regenerated in v2 (`replacedBy` in `scripts/images/sources.json`). The v1 file stays until the app switches. |

| Code | Issue | Images |
|---|---|---|
| T | fake text, logos or UI burnt in | 94 |
| F | film border or rebate | 25 |
| S | spa cliché (orchid, candle, stones, cucumber, petals, rolled towels, bamboo) | 66 |
| N | exposure or sensual crop | 12 |
| C | clinic or salon look | 11 |
| G | grading off (green or cool cast) | 5 |
| X | truth or voice issue | 3 |
| H | anatomy | 1 |
| P | posed, stock or beauty-ad look | 1 |

**Root cause.** The v1 prompts ended with *"Avoid: candles, stones, pebbles, orchids …"*. The `soul_2` model does not read negations reliably: it rendered the very props the sentence named (66 of 131 images carry one). It also adds film borders, fake captions and UI chrome (94 images), because it imitates social-media photography. v2 therefore uses **positive-only prompts** on `soul_2` and **GPT Image 2.5** (which follows exclusions) for every scene with people, props or text-prone surfaces (`generation/shotlist-v2.mjs`).

**Never use (pull from every surface now):** `portfolio/haare-styling-5`, `portfolio/make-up-5`, `portfolio/massage-4`, `portfolio/massage-14` (nudity), `portfolio/massage-11` (couples' massage, not offered), `editorial/hotel` (fake signage in the key hotel band).
